sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Unique-values dropdown: the native "Attributes" column (work-recordings, artist-relationships, place-performances, area-recordings, …) gets a new "Attributes" section — one entry per atomic recording-attribute word (e.g. "live", "cover", "partial"), decomposed from MusicBrainz's own natural-language-joined cell text (e.g. "cover and live") via a new `_findCellRecordingAttributeWords()` extractor, reusing the existing `REC_OF_ATTRIBUTES` vocabulary.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Unique-values dropdown: `/series/{mbid}` links (e.g. a user's "Series subscriptions" table) never surfaced an "Entity info - Series name"/"- Comment" section, even when carrying a real disambiguation comment (e.g. "3CD (Sony Music)") — `series` was absent from `_ENTITY_TYPE_GLYPH`, so `_findCellEntityRefs()` silently returned nothing for every series cell.
